versions.content: Transformation chain execution within cyclic function If Rte- ComDataMapping is configured for the VariableDataPrototype , then the RTE shall execute the data transformation for that data element within the cyclic function in the following cases: • The new data is received within configured cyclic time according to requirement [SWS_Rte_04655]. • E2E transformation is configured for the VariableDataPrototype and the waiting for new data period (calcuated as mentioned in [SWS_Rte_04661]) has been elapsed since the last data was received. The last received data from the Com should be passed to the transformation chain.
